data.title: A chatbot from customer chat history

message.text: We want to train a chatbot on 50,000 customer chats with the service team.

notes.text: No customer consent for this use yet.

cells: Send it to Jl. Melati No. 5, phone 0812-xxxx-3301

explanation: The chats contain addresses and phone numbers, and customers never agreed to their data training an AI. Escalate to the Data Protection Officer.
hints: Read the sample chats. Any personal data?
